LanguageData.RatkinQL_HuntedTree_Report: A terrified ratkin has arrived at the colony, pursued by unknown enemies.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Hunted_Greeting: A ratkin stumbles and scrambles to your gate, gasping for breath. "They're right behind me—please, {Interviewer_labelShort}, you have to decide now!"
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Hunted_OptFight: Take him in and face the pursuers
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Hunted_OptStory: Quickly ask why he’s being hunted
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Hunted_OptTurnAway: Send him away before trouble arrives
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Hunted_Story1: He insulted a Warlord’s lieutenant—now every mercenary in the sector wants his head.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Hunted_Story2: A bounty was pinned on him for a crime he didn’t commit. Bounty hunters are closing in.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Hunted_Story3: He overheard something in the RKU underground—and they don’t leave loose ends.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Hunted_Farewell: He nods grimly and vanishes into the wild.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Hunted_MsgFight: You grab your weapon and shove the ratkin behind you—the pursuers are already at the gate.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Hunted_MsgTurnAway: You push him out the door. He stumbles into the wilderness, the shadows of his hunters following close behind.
